method: Separate Vite library builds with identical target, minifier, and single-file output; gzip level 9. Both apps mount one button counter and update its text from native click state.
limitations: This measures a minimal counter, not a representative application or equivalent feature coverage.
The prototype omits most React features; this result cannot establish equal-capability size.
Build output includes the app entry and all reachable runtime/library code; source maps are excluded.
